descriptions.w3d_d25b_table_write_80098f24: Character-table write: builds a string (0x803426b8, 0x802cd220, 0x802cd128), appends every entry of the null-terminated table 0x803f4b50 with mode 7 (0x802cbf2c), writes the text to the sink at +32 with mode 9 (0x802cbdf8), clears +36 and +40 and destroys the string.
